messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — AcmeBio POC is ready to sign but procurement has a few blockers around the MSA/DPA and PO routing. Can legal review quickly?
anya_procurement: They want PO before production & require DocuSign routing to three signers: procurement -> director -> finance. Also need invoice to be net45, not net30.
liz_legal: Ok. Which MSA redlines are they pushing? Any non-standard clauses?
devon_eng: Technical note: they also flagged 'bring your own key' for KMS in the DPA and want an on-prem deployment option listed in the order form. Not a blocker for POC but for scale.
anya_procurement: Primary legal asks: 1) add SCCs for data transfers (EU tenant) 2) tighten subprocessor list visibility 3) signature acceptance via delegated signer (they use a signing authority that isn't the exec).
maria_ps: Pricing piece: POC discount applied in order form CSV; AcmeBio says discounts must be explicit on invoice. We can add a line item: "POC - 3wk trial - 50% off".
liz_legal: For SCCs — we can reference standard EU SCC addendum. I'll draft a short DPA addendum. For delegated signer we need a power-of-attorney clause or confirmation email chain — is that acceptable?
anya_procurement: They prefer delegated signer + procurement confirmation email thread. PO number won't be provided until after signature. Is that acceptable to finance?
sam_sales: Finance may accept invoice referencing the signed order form and then append PO, but they said it needs an invoice <= 30 days after signing.
liz_legal: We can insert an order form clause: "Invoice may reference the subsequently issued PO; Customer shall provide PO within 30 days of signature." Will that satisfy procurement?
anya_procurement: We'll try. Also, DocuSign routing: procurement @procurement@example.com -> delegated_signer@acme.com -> finance@acme.com. Can you configure in envelope?
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared (draft) — routing order set. Please confirm signer emails and who gets copy.
devon_eng: Small ask: add a line in order form for "Private deployment option: VPC-onprem (quote separate)" so we don't promise it for POC.
maria_ps: I'll update the order form CSV snippet and pricing lines. Sample snippet:```
Item,Qty,Unit Price,Discount
POC seat (month),3,1000,50%
Onboarding fee,1,2000,0%
```
liz_legal: I'll push a DPA addendum and a short delegated-signer attestation clause. Can we get Acme to sign the DPA first or bundle with the order form?
sam_sales: They want to sign in one flow. Can we bundle DPA + order form into the same DocuSign envelope?
liz_legal: Yes — we can include DPA as an addendum attachment in envelope. Need internal approval for SCC text. I'll ping security.
anya_procurement: Procurement also asked if we accept a credit card for POC to avoid PO delay. Any objections?
maria_ps: No objection for POC if amount < $5k and legal ok with billing terms. Otherwise need invoice flow.
devon_eng: One more: SLA section — they asked for p99 latency target in dedicated env. We should mark that as "dedicated offering only" and not part of hosted POC.
liz_legal: Good call. I'll add a clause: "SLA commitments (p99 latency, dedicated deployments) apply only to Dedicated and Private offers; hosted POC provided as-is."
sam_sales: Great. Next steps: liz to post redline bundle (DPA addendum + order form with delegated-signer clause), maria to update pricing CSV, docusign-bot to prepare envelope routing. I'll loop in security for SCCs.
liz_legal: Draft incoming in ~2h. Ping me in thread if Acme pushes for immediate e-sign. :thumbsup:
anya_procurement: Thanks everyone. I'll keep Acme updated — they want to close this week.
